notes.title: Past Mistakes – Episode 2 v0.2: Release Date!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey hey everyone! It's that time again! 🙂🍾[/p][p]We’re super excited to finally share the release date for [b]Episode 2 v0.2[/b] of [b]Past Mistakes[/b]! 🏆

The new update is scheduled for release on the same day as the [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b], [b]September 29th[/b]. Don't miss your chance to grab a copy if you haven't already!  As always thank you so much for your support! 💜[/p]

notes.title: Weekly Devlog #4 – Past Mistakes! 🏆
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496056/0ee40cee1e32a427607d8ba4e2b315cc871a6098.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone! 😏[/p][p]This week, AB & Nethuum reviewed and finalized the full content plan for the next update. One of the key steps will be an upcoming version of Episode 2 v0.3. This update will include three complete scenes, with one of them focusing on Jade’s route. The remaining scenes will appear in other releases.[/p][p]As soon as we have a release date or any extra details, we’ll post a full announcement so everyone can be ready.[/p][p]Meanwhile, AB started adding the content to our DLCs, which will be available in the next update.[/p][p]We also posted a new preview, giving you more art to enjoy while we work on the next phase. Link: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3302660/view/564760639011029323?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support—it keeps us motivated and moving forward! Stay tuned for more updates and what’s coming next. 💜[/p]

notes.title: Past Mistakes - Episode 2 v0.2 Preview #3!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! 😋😋😋[/p][p]Here’s a brand-new exclusive scene from Jade’s route! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496056/c1f8d33401f086c66529c2dc8ef086c842f7552e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]While the group is staying at the inn for the night, Phoebe takes a moment to explain to Cyrus how some things in the magical world actually work. It’s a quieter, more intimate exchange that sheds light on the rules of this new reality while deepening their bond.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy this glimpse of what’s coming in Episode 2—there’s a lot more to discover soon![/p]

notes.title: Weekly Devlog #3 – Past Mistakes! 🏆
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496056/0ee40cee1e32a427607d8ba4e2b315cc871a6098.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone! 😋[/p][p]Here’s a quick look at what we’ve been working on this week:[/p][p][b]Scene Progress:[/b] AB has edited about half of Scene 3 for the upcoming update, moving things steadily forward.[/p][p][b]Wallpaper Set:[/b] Nethuum & AB have already planned out this month’s wallpaper set, deciding on both the location and the characters. The release is scheduled for next week, since we’re currently juggling the new Past Mistakes update.[/p][p][b]Potential New Features:[/b] We’ve also been discussing some possible additions for the next update, including the ability to jump to a specific game version, new options on some DLCs.[/p][p][b]Coming Soon:[/b] Expect new previews and more news very soon—so stay tuned![/p][p]Thanks as always for the amazing support! 💜[/p]

notes.title: Weekly Devlog #2 – Past Mistakes! 🏆
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496056/0ee40cee1e32a427607d8ba4e2b315cc871a6098.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]Here’s what we’ve been working on this week:[/p][p]AB has fully added Scene 3 into the game’s code and also kicked off the editing and rendering process for it. Things are moving smoothly, and this scene is starting to take shape nicely.[/p][p]We also dropped a brand-new preview for Episode 2 (\[[url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3302660/view/547870056202108938"]link[/url]]) so you can get another little taste of what’s coming soon.[/p][p]On top of that, we’ve started organizing this month’s Wallpaper Set, which will feature a lingerie theme—definitely one to look forward to![/p][p]And finally, about the fanart: the next poll will go live once the current game scenes are wrapped up or as soon as the team finds a window of time. We’ve already picked some characters for the lineup, and the date for the poll will be announced soon.[/p][p]Thanks again for sticking with us—lots of exciting stuff is on the way! 🏆[/p]

notes.title: Past Mistakes - Episode 2 v0.2 Preview #2!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey y'all! 🫵[/p][p]As the group continues their journey, the question of where to rest for the night comes up.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496056/c7ec1a24585c3088d6bd357b26b536f6b59c6fdc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Jade steps in with a practical idea—finding an inn where everyone can finally relax and recover their energy before moving forward. This moment highlights the party’s dynamic, showing how each character contributes in their own way as they prepare for what awaits them at the mysterious academy.

Have a nice day! 💫[/p]

notes.title: Weekly Devlog #1 – Past Mistakes! 🏆
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496056/0ee40cee1e32a427607d8ba4e2b315cc871a6098.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone! 👀[/p][p]This week has been packed with progress, and we’re excited to share the highlights with you:[/p][p]AB wrapped up the rendering for scenes 1 and 2, bringing more visual polish and detail to the upcoming update.[/p][p]Three freshly edited scenes have been fully integrated into the game’s code, pushing us one step closer to the next release.[/p][p]We dropped a brand-new preview for you to check out [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3302660/view/501707525343676182" buttoncolor="#ff0000"]here[/url] and also shared a stunning fanart on our other socials.[/p][p]The full scene lineup for Episode 2 v0.2 has been finalized, locking in what’s coming next for the story.[/p][p]Behind the scenes, AB & Nethuum are working on a new fanart and already planning the poll for next week’s community pick.[/p][p]Every week we’re getting closer to delivering more content, so stay tuned—things are heating up!

notes.title: Past Mistakes - OUT NOW on Steam! 🏆
notes.notes:
[p]We’re proud to announce that [b]Past Mistakes – Act I is officially available on Steam[/b]! Development for this chapter started earlier this year, and thanks to the incredible support of our community, we're thrilled to bring you the next big step in Cyrus’s journey. 
[/p][p]Cyrus continues to adapt to his new reality, juggling two worlds, growing tension, and choices that now carry even more weight.
[/p][p]🏆 Some of the exciting features include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Three main routes[/b], each with their own unique characters, story beats, and endings! You pick your class (mage, warrior or archer).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stunning animations[/b] including variants, showing fights, action, and drama with fluid, smooth movement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]1000+ beautiful 3D-rendered CG content[/b] depicting the story rendered in sharp, crisp 4K resolution for the highest quality.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Original soundtrack[/b], featuring all tracks composed exclusively for the game so far.[/p][/*][*][p][b]18 achievements[/b] across all Episodes & DLCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Official Brazilian-Portuguese translation throughout the entire game.
[/p][/*][/list][p]To celebrate this launch, [b]Past Mistakes[/b] is available now with a [b]20% discount[/b] — a great time to pick up the game!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3302660/Past_Mistakes___Act_I/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This is still an Early Access project, and your feedback is crucial. Whether it's bugs, suggestions, or thoughts about the story, we’re always listening — feel free to share your experiences via reviews or in our community hub.
[/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who’s supported us so far — by wishlisting, sharing, joining our Discord, etc. And of course, a special thank you to our dedicated dev team that made this release possible! 💜[/p][p]Let’s keep building this world together.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Cock-N-Tiel Studios Team[/i]
[/p]

notes.title: Past Mistakes Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hi and hello to all of our followers!

We’ve hit a major milestone in the development of our new game, Past Mistakes. We’ve just finished up work on the [b]demo version[/b], which is now available as a [b]free download on Steam[/b]!

The demo includes the opening moments of Past Mistakes, introducing our main villains and the protagonist, Cyrus. Cyrus is an ordinary office worker thrust into the world of Cadagan, where every person he meets has a counterpart in the real world! Cadagan is in danger, under attack by a hostile, magical enemy force. With the queen of the realm dethroned and the kingdom captured, Cyrus is somehow the only one who can stop them!

Check out the demo and [b]wishlist the game clicking on the link below[/b] if you haven’t already!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3302660/Past_Mistakes___Act_I/
